item.title: Hello, Condensate
item.description: This is the first sample post. Condensate keeps the page almost entirely type: a slab-serif title, a condensed date line, and a comfortable serif for reading.

item.title: A sample technical post with code
item.description: Technical posts are the point of this theme, so code blocks get a copy button and syntax colors that follow the light and dark setting.

item.title: Notes from a conference
item.description: A third sample post so the home page paginates. The summary is generated from the first paragraph, or you can set description in the front matter to control it exactly.

item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Jane. This page is a normal Markdown file at content/about.md, so you can write whatever you like here: paragraphs, headings, lists, images and links.

You can find me on GitHub, Bluesky and Mastodon.

Get in touch
